limitations: Same-host local keyword-only indexed benchmark. Compiled candidate is an uncommitted snapshot, with explicit content hashes. Three alternating fixed-count samples are not CI matrix performance proof. Durable writes include filesystem sync; baseline verified PutConfident uses its historical second transaction and returns no identity, candidate verified writes return the atomic receipt. Setup is excluded and corpus grows by 10 writes per sample. No vector expansion costs are represented.
interpretation: Fixed-count three-sample same-host experiment; medians and full min/max ranges reported without significance claims. Nonempty result counts and eligible filtered warmup were asserted. Complete normal Recall access bookkeeping and durable Put are included. Source hashes identify compiled candidate snapshot despite subsequent concurrent documentation/API changes.
